scope: Proposition 7.3 (Essential polygons in a slab) of the manuscript “Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments” (preprints/Uniform-marked-polygon-estimates-and-sharp-finite-bridge-moments-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e9b7a0252f329287), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants c, C > 0 such that, for every sufficiently large integer N and every horizontal slab S of height CN in the cylinder obtained by quotienting by N horizontal lattice steps, X γ⊂S γ simple essential polygon κℓ(γ) ≥ c. Here essential means noncontractible in the cylinder, and the polygons are unoriented and unrooted.
